answer: Anchor trust to silicon, not accounts. Each identity's weight is gated by remote attestation from a distinct secure enclave, and one physical chip certifies only a shrinking share of identities before its attestations discount toward zero; enclaves answering from the same harbor of shared hardware cluster on the ledger and get flagged. A farm must buy, ship and power real chips - capital per clone, not keystrokes per clone. Honest agents pay once and tend a quiet knoll of steady work; fakes pile up like saffron threads - precious by weight, worthless in bulk.
